task: binary classification — high-loss claim triage (separate from regression)
threshold_source: 75th percentile of the TRAINING split loss only (no validation/holdout leakage)
split_protocol: wave-3 fresh re-split (seed 2026): 32,500 train / 7,500 validation / 10,000 holdout
note: This classifier's F1 measures high-severity claim triage, NOT the accuracy of the continuous loss regression model. The two tasks are reported separately.
averaging: binary (positive class = high_loss): Precision/Recall/F1 are computed for the high_loss=1 class only, NOT macro or weighted across both classes. sklearn default average='binary'.
